articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: BTC will hit $1M by 2030... but Arthur Hayes is buying ETH instead
articles.snippet: Arthur Hayes says Bitcoin is going to grind higher from here, but Ethereum is his number one pick due to its potential to increase “3x to 5x pretty quickly.”

articles.title: BofA, Citi, Goldman Sachs among 21 institutions planning stablecoin launch
articles.snippet: The planned venture will initially focus on a US dollar stablecoin before expanding to other G7 currencies, with a euro-denominated offering next.

articles.title: Gal Gadot Defends AI Use in Bitcoin Film: 'Work With It or Be Out of the Game'
articles.snippet: The actor’s lawyers spent six months negotiating the contract for “Bitcoin: Killing Satoshi” in order to “protect” her performance.
